$comment: THE FROZEN SCORING DENOMINATOR for phase 394's stage-2 dedup lane (D-04/D-16).
Gap-closure rounds MUST NOT mint new members or edit these vectors to re-score:
the whole proof is that this exact table is observed RED with no dedup lane in
existence and green at the end of the phase, with nothing added in between (the
treadmill law). A row that stops catching what its rationale claims is a finding
about the lane, never a reason to move the row.
THE ONE ADJUDICATED SUSPENSION OF THAT LAW, 2026-08-13 (round 5). The freeze above
protects a table that measures the RIGHT INPUT. It did not. 394-VERIFICATION round
4, gap SC-1 stage 2, found that every row's 'intent' was a whole test DOCUMENT,
projected [name, ...steps].join(' '), while production hands dedupBeforeAuthor
input.intent -- a person's one-line utterance, with no steps at all (loop.ts:858).
There IS no document at stage 2; having none is the entire premise of
dedup-BEFORE-author. So the table pinned an input shape no caller can emit, and no
mutation of the lane could red on the distribution production actually sees: the
obvious-duplicate row reached 0.5 only because its 'intent' carried 21 tokens. The
verifier measured the consequence over the whole shipping suite -- an intent that is
a committed test's name VERBATIM scored 0.1818 / 0.2000 / 0.3077 / 0.1579 / 0.1500 /
0.2000 / 0.3810 / 0.4000 / 0.2917 / 0.3000, ten of ten ADMIT, ceiling 0.40 against a
0.45 pin (WINDOWS 118).
WHAT THE RE-MINT CHANGED AND WHAT IT DID NOT. Changed: every row's intent side is
now a one-line utterance read out of intents/<file>'s single `intent:` key, and every
score/sharedTokens vector was re-measured on that real input shape. NOT changed: every
pre-existing row keeps its `id` and its SOLE CATCHER rationale, so the property each
row was minted to be the only catcher of is still the property it catches. Three rows
were added, and only the three the verification's own `missing:` list names --
exact-name-utterance (WINDOWS 118 itself, the live reading as a cell) and the two
outside-the-name-axis-assumption rows step-detailed-refuse / step-detailed-admit. No
further denominator was minted.
WHY THE SUITE IS COPIED. suite/uat-381-*.yaml are VERBATIM copies of
demo/init/tests/uat-381-*.yaml, which is the suite 393's frozen corpus scores
against, so the two denominators describe the same world. The copy exists because
the demo tree lives in the super-repository, outside this package's repository, so
no test in packages/agent can read it. 393's corpus solved the same problem by
copying the TEXTS into TypeScript; copying the documents is strictly stronger,
because what is copied is still in the producer's own format. The suite side is
STILL a document, and that is not an inconsistency: a corpus ENTRY is a committed
test, which has a name and steps, and only the INTENT side was ever wrong.
SYNTHETIC SUITE IDENTITIES. dedup-tie-alpha, dedup-tie-beta and
dedup-unfingerprinted carry demo-style workspace-relative identity paths for
members the demo suite does not contain. They exist because two properties have no
home in the real suite: no intent can tie uat-381-ladder against
uat-381-ladder-current-target (their token sets differ by exactly one member, and
the Jaccard denominators differ by one, so equal scores force a shared count of
zero), and the real suite has no member standing for a test the derived
fingerprint index has no rows for.
score/sharedTokens/comparedTests are what the SHIPPED textOverlap ACTUALLY produced
over these files, and the vectors in this file are the PRE-FIX ones: measured
2026-08-13 against the recipe shipping at that moment, textOverlap({testName:
intent, steps: []}, entry). They are recorded before any fix exists so the RED is a
reading rather than a prediction; Task 2 of 394-31 re-measures them through the
fixed recipe. The expected VERDICT column is frozen NOW and is not re-measured --
it is what D-04 says the lane must answer. score is written to ten decimal places
because the boundary triple is decided in the fourth.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: a near-duplicate intent is refused at all. The utterance says what uat-381-local-form's name says and adds one detail the test already covers. If this row admits, the lane does not screen.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: top score 0.2962962963 against uat-381-local-form (8 shared of 11+24), then 0.1481481481 and 0.1851851852 against the two ladder members. BELOW the pin, so the lane shipping today ADMITS it -- this row is part of the recorded RED. The re-minted utterance replaces a 21-token document projection that reached 0.5 only because it carried the test's whole step list.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the lane still ADMITS. A threshold that refuses everything passes a refuse-only corpus, so the exclusion leg needs a control leg beside it or 'it refused' is a reading from an instrument that cannot read. The utterance is a genuinely new intent in the class the live lane's leg C authored -- a heading assertion no member of this suite makes.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: top score 0.1724137931 against uat-381-local-form (5 shared of 10+24). Note what the pre-fix number says about the whole table: on the producible input distribution the strongest accept control in the corpus sits 0.2776 below the pin, so there is no near-miss anywhere and the headroom claim in dedup.ts's threshold comment was measured on documents no caller can send.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the >= direction. Its score equals the pin to the digit, so a lane written with > admits it and this row is the only one that says so. The utterance carries exactly nine distinct tokens and every one of them is a uat-381-ladder token, which is what lands the Jaccard on 9/20.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.4500000000 against uat-381-ladder (9 shared of 9+20). 9/20 and the literal 0.45 are the same IEEE-754 double, so the equality is exact rather than approximate. 0.2222222222 against uat-381-local-form and 0.3636363636 against uat-381-ladder-current-target. Worth naming because it constrains any future recipe: current-target carries the ladder's NAME byte-for-byte at a lexicographically SMALLER path, so a recipe that ever scored these two equally would hand this row's refusal to current-target and the `matched` column would red before the verdict did.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the step immediately BELOW the pin admits. Pairs with at-threshold and above-threshold as the boundary triple; a lane that rounded, clamped or compared at reduced precision would fail here first.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.1538461538 against uat-381-local-form (4 shared of 6+24). Under the shipping recipe this row is nowhere near the boundary it is supposed to instrument -- the pre-fix table has no boundary triple on the producible distribution at all, which is the finding rather than a defect of the row.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the step immediately ABOVE the pin refuses. The other half of the boundary triple. Below and above straddle the pin within a hundredth on each side, so the triple pins a point rather than a region.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.2222222222 against uat-381-local-form (6 shared of 9+24), 0.0740740741 and 0.1111111111 against the ladder pair. Below the pin, so today's lane admits it and this row is part of the recorded RED.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: WINDOWS 118, the strongest duplicate signal that can exist. The intent is not written anywhere -- it is READ OUT of the matched member's own name, so the row cannot drift from the suite it screens against. If a lane cannot refuse a test's name handed back to it verbatim, its refusal arm is unreachable for every real input, which is exactly what the live leg D of 394-30 measured and what the round-4 verification then generalised to ten of ten committed tests.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.2916666667 against uat-381-local-form (7 shared of 7+24) -- the verifier's 0.2917 reproduced to ten places through the shipped recipe. TOTAL CONTAINMENT and still an admit: all seven intent tokens are member tokens, and the Jaccard denominator carries the 17 step tokens the intent structurally cannot match. This row is the centre of the recorded RED.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: an empty suite admits every intent and reports NO closest match. Deliberately driven by the obvious-duplicate intent, the strongest refusal candidate in the table, so the row says the empty corpus admits it rather than that some weak intent slipped through. The first test a project ever writes must not be refused for resembling nothing.
rows.measured: comparedTests 0, no closest reported, no-duplicate arm. There is no score to record because nothing was compared. Unaffected by the round-5 re-mint in every respect except which utterance drives it.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the degenerate 0/0 is not an identity. An empty intent against a suite entry with an empty name and no steps scores 0, not 1. Reading it as 1 would let a single empty corpus entry cover every intent ever screened -- an over-flag so complete the safe direction becomes a lane that always refuses. The rule is INHERITED from textSimilarity's own early return rather than re-derived here; this row is the assertion that dedup did not add a second reading of it.
rows.measured: score 0, no-duplicate. This is the ONE row with no fixture behind it: the empty intent is not an utterance anybody types, it is the degenerate input, and the corpus says so rather than pretending a producer emitted it. Unchanged by the round-5 re-mint, and the only row for which that is true by construction.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: tie-break stability. Two suite members score identically, and the refusal must name the lexicographically smallest workspace-relative identity path so two invocations against the same suite report the same duplicate. beta is fed BEFORE alpha on purpose -- a lane that kept natural iteration order, or that used a strict > on the running best, names beta and this row is the only one that notices.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: alpha and beta both 0.4210526316 (8 shared of 9+18), bit-identical because their documents carry identical text at different paths, and BOTH BELOW the pin -- so under the shipping recipe this row admits and its tie-break is never reached. The three real members trail at 0.1785714286 / 0.1600000000 / 0.2500000000.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: the comparison universe is EVERY test in the suite. dedup-unfingerprinted stands for a member the derived fingerprint index has no rows for -- exactly the population gate 3's text lane keeps and gate 3's fingerprint lane drops, and exactly the population a corpus narrowed to the fingerprint-covered subset would lose. The row also pins comparedTests at the full suite size, so a lane that filtered its input reds here on the count before it reds on the match.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.5882352941 against dedup-unfingerprinted (10 shared of 10+17), then 0.0967741935 / 0.1111111111 / 0.1071428571 against the three real members. comparedTests 4. An intent has no execution fingerprint, so the anchor-sequence recipe cannot fire pre-run -- this is why the pre-run screen must read the suite rather than the index.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: a refusal reached from OUTSIDE the name-axis assumption. The utterance is long and step-detailed rather than name-shaped -- it names no test, it recites a procedure -- and it near-duplicates uat-381-local-form's whole document. A guard whose corpus cases are all drawn from inside its own assumption is tested only where it already believes; this row is the refuse-direction case drawn from outside it.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: 0.5555555556 against uat-381-local-form (15 shared of 18+24), 0.4615384615 and 0.4444444444 against the ladder pair. ABOVE the pin already, so this row is GREEN before the fix -- and that is its second job: it is the witness that the round-5 recipe change is monotone upward and took no refusal away.

rows.rationale: SOLE CATCHER for: an admit reached from OUTSIDE the name-axis assumption. A long, step-detailed utterance that recites a procedure no member of the suite performs -- a heading and a field LABEL, neither asserted anywhere in this suite. Without it, 'the lane still admits' is only ever demonstrated on short name-shaped utterances, and a recipe that refused every long sentence would pass the corpus.
rows.measured: PRE-FIX, 2026-08-13: top score 0.2666666667 against uat-381-local-form (8 shared of 14+24), then 0.2592592593 and 0.2500000000. Long and heavily overlapping in vocabulary with all three members and still comfortably admitting, which is the property: length alone must not refuse.
